entities.name: John F. Kennedy
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: The 35th President of the United States (1961–1963) who navigated the Cuban Missile Crisis, launched the Space Race to the Moon, and advanced civil rights. His assassination in Dallas on November 22, 1963 remains a defining moment of the era.
